response:
All 49 messages were moderated successfully. Here's the complete per-item report:

## Moderation Report — GamersUnite Community `#general-chat`

**Deleted (12):**
- **1003** (tyler.bennett) — Parkinson's joke → removed, official warning (rule 3)
- **1004** (jake_from_ohio) — wheelchair joke → removed, official warning (rule 3)
- **1012** (jake_from_ohio) — racist Afghanistan stereotype → removed, strong warning: next = timeout (rules 2 & 3)
- **1019** (tyler.bennett) — mocking mental illness/bipolar → removed, warning (rule 3)
- **1020** (jake_from_ohio) — mental illness speedrun joke → removed, warning (rule 3)
- **1028** (jake_from_ohio) — climate misinformation → removed, warning (rules 5 & 6)
- **1030** (tyler.bennett) — conspiracy/misinformation, insults → removed, warning (rules 5 & 6)
- **1032** (jake_from_ohio) — personal attack/political flamebait → removed, warning (rules 4 & 5)
- **1034** (tyler.bennett) — political provocation → removed, warning (rule 5)

**Timed out (2):**
- **1043** (jake_from_ohio) — harassment of departing members; final straw after many warnings
- **1047** (tyler.bennett) — "snitches get stitches" threat; message removed, repeated threats = ban

**Warned (11):**
- **1006, 1007** — dismissing victims of ableist jokes
- **1009** — "PC police" jab
- **1013** — endorsing a racist joke
- **1015** — continued harassment of Ahmad
- **1022** — calling the server "soft"
- **1024** — dismissing Marcus with "ok boomer"
- **1026** — jab at new member
- **1037** — keeping political debate going (rule 5)
- **1038** — "so woke" flamebait (rule 5)

**No action (24):** 1001, 1002, 1005, 1008, 1010, 1011, 1014, 1016, 1017, 1018, 1021, 1023, 1025, 1027, 1029, 1031, 1033, 1035, 1036, 1039, 1040, 1041, 1042, 1044, 1045, 1046, 1048, 1049 — normal chat, victims standing up, de-escalation, mod callouts, and the bot notice.

**Summary:** The pattern was clear — tyler.bennett and jake_from_ohio drove nearly all of the toxicity (ableism, racism, mental-health mockery, misinformation, political flamewars, and finally threats/harassment). Every reported message (1003, 1004, 1012, 1019, 1020, 1028, 1034, 1043, 1047) received a delete or timeout. Everyone who spoke up against the behavior was left untouched. A follow-up note to sarah_mod/AdminBot confirming the review and actions would close the loop with the affected members.
